title: Finite-Temperature Micromagnetics of Hysterisis for Misaligned Single Iron Nanopillars
abstract: We present micromagnetic results for the hysterisis of a single magnetic nanopillar which is misaligned with respect to the applied magnetic field. We provide results for both a one dimensional stack of magnetic rotors and of full micromagnetic simulations. The results are compared to the Stoner-Wohlfarth model.
